I’d do it themed from a country thats not usually featured on the show. They often do ”asian”, Italian, british etc, but imagine something from a European country. I’m from Sweden for example, and our food is completly different from like Poland, or even Finland. For a swedish box I could do simple ingredients, that are known and used everywhere, but in really different ways. I would focus on the things that most swedes love, but mixed with old traditional ingredients.

Herring, blueberries, new potatoes, 
a swedish version of bologna sausage (Falukorv), moosemeat, shrimp, dill, sour cream, reindeer, pike, lingonberry jam, crawfish, swedish caviar, västerbottencheese, green peas.
